mainEntity.name: What kind of data does AI SEO use to optimize my dental practice website?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO utilizes a diverse range of data points to optimize your dental practice website. This includes keyword search volume and difficulty, competitor website analysis, backlink profiles, user behavior data (like click-through rates and bounce rates), content performance metrics, and search engine algorithm updates. It also processes local search data, patient demographics, and industry trends to create comprehensive, data-driven strategies. This holistic approach allows for highly effective and continuously improving optimization.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO uses data like keyword research, competitor analysis, user behavior, content performance, and local search trends to optimize your dental practice website.
